tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ khrid yig nyi zla gza' skar bzhugs pa lags so/ /

rin chen shog 'dra'i skor/ / ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng rtsal yab yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las dang skal bar ldan pa zhig /snang byed 'od kyi lus sgrub na/ /de yi khrid kyi rim pa ni/ /nyi zla gza' skar lugs su gdab/ /'dir mkha' 'gro snying tig gi man ngag gi khrid tshar ba dang grol ba dus mtshungs par 'dod na/ dpon slob kun 'jig rten gyi bya ba snying nas thongs pas/ rab tu dben pa'i nags khrod dam/ rgya mtsho chu gling ngam/ dur khrod dam/ mi med pa'i lung stong chen por phyin la/ lto gos kyi zhen pa bcad/ rdo'i bcud len dang*/ gtum mo'i lag khrid bslabs la/ bla mas slob bu la/ phyi nam zla dus bzhi/ nang 'byung bzhi'i 'gyur ldog /gsang ba skad cig thangs gcig yud tsam 'gyur bas kyang rang gi tshe mi rtag par 'chi nges pa'i skyo shas drag po zla ba gcig tu bsgom du bcug nas/ mi nas bzung ste 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sems pa la zla ba gcig blo sbya ོ nga ngo*/ /de nas 'khor ba'i rgyu mi dge bar shes pas 'dor zhing bshags pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu dge bar shes pas 'dor len la zla ba gcig sbya ོ nga ngo*/ /de nas dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam ste/ sgrib pa sbyong pa'i mchog yi ge brgya pa'i sgom bzlas la zla ba gcig sbya ོ nga ngo*/ /de nas tshogs bsags pa'i yan lag phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal zla ba gcig sbya ོ nga ngo*/ /de nas byin rlabs 'jug pa'i gtso bo pad+ma thod phreng gi thugs sgrub la zla ba gcig sbya ོ nga ngo*/ /de nas dbang dang gdams pa gnyis chun gcig gis rdzogs par byed de/ thog mar mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur nas/ de'i sgrub pa la zla ba gsum sbya ོ nga ngo*/ /de nas spros bcas bum dbang bskur nas/ rigs lnga'i phyi nang gi sgrub pa la zla ba drug sbyong ngo*/ /de nas lus ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa la zhag nyi shu dang*/ rdo rje skyil krung zhag bcur sbyang ngo*/

/de nas spros med gsang dbang bskur la/ ngag ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa zhag nyi shu byas la/ phyi snang ba la rgyas gdab/ nang phung po la rgyas gdab/ rtsal sbyang gnyis/ mnyen btsal lam gzhug dang bcas pa rnams la/ zhag nyi shu nyi shu byas nas/ nang gi sngon 'gro yi ge gsum gyi bzlas pa zla ba gcig dang zhag bcu byas la/ gtum mo zla ba gcig dang*/ rlung zla ba gsum bsgom mo/ /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang rten can nam/ rten med du bskur la yum mkha' ngo sprod nas/ sems ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa la zhag nyi shu/ byung gnas 'gro gsum la zhag dgur brtags la/ rnal 'bebs zhag gsum dang*/ sor 'jug zhag gsum gyis zhi gnas ngo sprad la/ ma ning gi rlung zla ba gcig bsgoms la/ rdo rje chu 'thung dang*/ chu 'dren zla ba gnyis sbyangs te/ rang lus sam gzhan lus la brten nas zla ba gsum dang zhag bcur bde stong la bslab bo/ /de nas tshig dbang bla ma'i dbang bskur la/ / dang por rtog pa rtsad bcad pa la zhag gsum bar du sems kyi mtshang btsal ba la zhag gsum/ tha ma byung gnas 'gro gsum la zhag gsum gyi rjes la/ lhag mthong gi ye shes khreg chod ngo sprad de/ bogs 'byin dang rtsal sbyong la lus ngag yid gsum dril ba'i spyod pa zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bya'o/ /de nas sgo gsum gyi bya ba btang ba la zhag gsum/ bzhugs stangs gsum la zhag gsum song nas/ rtsal dbang bskur te mngon sum ngo sprad nas/ nyin dus 'od gsal gyi snang ba dang*/ mtshan dus bde stong gi 'od gsal nyi zla kha sbyor zla ba drug bsgoms pas/ nyams gong du 'phel te/ zla ba bcu gcig bsgoms pas rig pa tshad la phebs so/ /de nas zla ba bcu gsum na chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba mthong ste ka dag gi grol gzhi la btsan sa lo phyed nas zin te 'od lus su yal te 'tshang rgya'o/ /de yang chos nyid mngon sum gyi dus na bde stong 'od gsal du nub par byed do/

/nyams gong 'phel gyi dus na 'od gsal 'dzin med du nub par byed do/ /rig pa tshad phebs kyi dus na 'dzin med kyi shes pa'ang mtha' grol du nub par byed do/ /chos nyid zad pa'i dus na mtha' grol gdod ma'i ka dag gi sar nub par byed do/ /gdod ma'i ka dag bum pa'i skur nang gsal du gnas pas/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dgongs pa la lhun gyis grub bo/ /de ltar mdor dril bas zla ba bdun cu rtsa gnyis te/ lo drug na zag pa dang bcas pa'i phung po mi snang bar gdod ma'i sa la 'tshang rgya bar nges pa'o/ /de ltar rab gsal bla med snying po'i don/ /nyi zla gza' skar 'char nub tshul bzhin du/ /'od gsal kha sbyor rin chen snying po'i khrid/ /shing mo yos lo dpyid 'bring nag pas nya/ /gza' tshes 'dzom par dpal gyi mchims phu der/ /pad ma las 'brel rtsal la dgongs gter babs/ /yang cig de yi snga lo ston 'bring la/ /pad+ma dkar por bka' srung srog sgrub mas/ /dgongs gter dpe rnams dngos su gtad pa rmis/ /de nas bzung ste gter srung mkha' 'gro rnams/ /lus dang grib ma ji bzhin yod par mngon/ /'dir ni gangs ri thod dkar o rgyan rdzong*/ / dben zhing nyams dga' rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas/ /ston gsum me tog 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ /nyi zla gza' skar gsang ba'i khrid yig 'di/ /shog 'dra'i ngos la phyi rabs don du bkod/ /dge ba de yis srid pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /tshe 'dir 'bras bu 'od gsal lus 'grub nas/ /spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin te/ /'pho ba chen pos gzhan don 'grub par shog / mkha' 'gro snying tig gi khrid yig nyi zla gza' skar lugs su gdab pa zhes bya ba pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gangs ri thod dkar du bkod pa rdzogs so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (7)khrid yig nyi zla gza' skar/ -PAGE 48--PAGE 49--PAGE 46-
